extracted.intended_audience: writers and creatives seeking literary or talent agency representation
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for writers on preparing and sending query/submission materials to the William Morris Agency (and similar literary/talent agencies), including what to include, who they represent, and where to send materials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Verify query/submission guidelines before sending
rubrics_metrics.description: The Market List recommends you verify the query and/or submission guidelines for each literary agent and literary agency before sending a query or submitting your manuscript.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Check the specific agent/agency requirements (as they can vary) and confirm up-to-date instructions before sending any materials. The page explicitly advises verifying guidelines for each agent/agency.

rubrics_metrics.name: Completed manuscript requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Most agencies require a completed manuscript prior to queries or submissions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Have a finished manuscript ready before querying or submitting, unless an individual agent's guidelines explicitly permit partial submissions or sample chapters.

rubrics_metrics.name: Verify agency requirements for new or unpublished writers and areas of interest
rubrics_metrics.description: Review and verify the agency requirements for working with new or unpublished writers as well as their specific areas of interest.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Confirm whether the agency (or a particular agent) accepts submissions from unpublished writers and whether your project's genre/topic matches the agent's stated interests.

rubrics_metrics.name: Standard query packet contents (cover letter, synopsis, publication history, SASE)
rubrics_metrics.description: For all queries, send a cover letter, synopsis, and publication history with a SASE.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assemble these core components for mailed queries: a succinct cover letter, a clear synopsis of the project, a list of prior publications (if any), and a self-addressed stamped envelope for reply. Follow any agent-specific variations if listed on their site.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission address and contact information
rubrics_metrics.description: Use the agency's provided physical address and contact points for submissions: 1325 Avenue of the Americas, New York NY 10019; phone (212) 586-5100; fax (212) 246-3583. Primary contacts and agent names are listed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Send materials to the listed submission address and include required packet items (e.g., SASE). Use the named contacts/agents to target queries where appropriate, but follow any agent-specific submission instructions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accepted material types / market scope
rubrics_metrics.description: William Morris Agency represents novels, non-fiction books, television and movie scripts (accepts: Fiction, non-fiction, television, film).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only submit projects that fall within the agency's represented markets—fiction, non-fiction, TV and film. Do not submit material outside these categories unless the agency states otherwise.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agency commission terms
rubrics_metrics.description: Agent receives 15% commission on domestic sales and 20% commission on foreign sales.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Be aware of the standard commission rates the agency charges; these are contractual/financial terms that affect any representation agreement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Refer to the agency website for full submission guidelines
rubrics_metrics.description: Submission guidelines and requirements are available on The William Morris Agency's website (www.wmeentertainment.com/).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the agency's official website for the most complete and current submission instructions and any additional requirements (formatting, electronic submissions, submission windows, etc.).
